rationale: Price is sitting in the upper 77% of today's range after a large gap-down open, with the last five 1-minute candles showing a stalling/fading pattern — a high of 77.92 rolling back to 77.39 — suggesting momentum is losing conviction near the 9-EMA ($77.38) and session VWAP ($76.84) is below. The broad market is under pressure (SPY -0.96%, VIXY +3.23%), making a sustained long push risky, while the stock has already bounced ~6% off today's low, reducing the reward-to-risk for a fresh long entry. With a working order already consuming 2% of buying power and today's realized P&L already negative, the evidence does not clearly favor either direction with sufficient edge to justify adding exposure.
